# 🎬 ShowTime ### ⚡ Movie Search & Discovery Web App

--- ## 🚀 Overview **ShowTime** is a modern React-based movie search application that allows users to explore movies, search titles, and view detailed information using real-time API data. It focuses on **performance, clean UI, and simplicity**, making it a great frontend project for learning API integration. --- ## ✨ Features * 🔍 Movie search functionality * 🎥 Movie details (poster, rating, overview) * ⚡ Fast API data fetching * 📱 Fully responsive design * 🎯 Minimal and clean UI --- ## 🏗️ Tech Stack * **Frontend:** React.js * **Backend:** Express.js * **Styling:** CSS3 * **Language:** JavaScript (ES6+)

name: block_41
text:
* **API:** OMDb API


---

## 📁 Folder Structure

Here is the **actual clean structure representation** of your project:

```bash
ShowTime/
│
├── public/
│   └── index.html              # Root HTML file
│
├── src/
│   │
│   ├── components/             # Reusable UI components
│   │   ├── MovieCard.js        # Displays individual movie
│   │   ├── SearchBar.js        # Search input component
│   │   └── (other components)
│   │
│   ├── App.js                  # Main app component
│   ├── App.css                 # Global styles
│   ├── index.js                # React entry point
│
├── package.json                # Project dependencies
├── package-lock.json           # Dependency lock file
└── README.md                   # Project documentation
```

---

## ⚙️ Getting Started

### 1️⃣ Clone Repository

```bash
git clone https://github.com/HarshadL2004/ShowTime.git
cd ShowTime

name: block_81
text:
```

---

### 2️⃣ Install Dependencies

```bash
npm install
```

---

### 3️⃣ Setup Environment Variables

Create a `.env` file in root:

```env
REACT_APP_API_KEY=your_api_key_here
```

---

### 4️⃣ Run the Application

**Frontend:**
```bash
npm run dev

```
**Backend:**
```bash

npm start
```

📍 App will run on:
**[http://localhost:3000](http://localhost:3000)**

---

## 🔌 API Integration

Example API call:

```javascript
fetch(`https://www.omdbapi.com/?apikey=${process.env.REACT_APP_API_KEY}&s=movie`)
```

# React + Vite

This template provides a minimal setup to get React working in Vite with HMR and some ESLint rules.

Currently, two official plugins are available:

- [@vitejs/plugin-react](https://github.com/vitejs/vite-plugin-react/blob/main/packages/plugin-react) uses [Babel](https://babeljs.io/) (or [oxc](https://oxc.rs) when used in [rolldown-vite](https://vite.dev/guide/rolldown)) for Fast Refresh
- [@vitejs/plugin-react-swc](https://github.com/vitejs/vite-plugin-react/blob/main/packages/plugin-react-swc) uses [SWC](https://swc.rs/) for Fast Refresh

## React Compiler

The React Compiler is not enabled on this template because of its impact on dev & build performances. To add it, see [this documentation](https://react.dev/learn/react-compiler/installation).

## Expanding the ESLint configuration

If you are developing a production application, we recommend using TypeScript with type-aware lint rules enabled. Check out the [TS template](https://github.com/vitejs/vite/tree/main/packages/create-vite/template-react-ts) for information on how to integrate TypeScript and [`typescript-eslint`](https://typescript-eslint.io) in your project.
